settings.heading: Settings
settings.securityHint: Changing the admin password signs out every session.
settings.loginRateHint: Failed attempts allowed per IP before locking (0 = disabled)
settings.loginRateLockHint: How long the IP stays locked after too many failures (0 = disabled)
settings.sessionTTLHint: How long an admin session stays valid (0 = never expires, minimum 5; changes affect new logins only)
settings.linkRateHint: Max short-link redirects per second across all codes (0 = unlimited)
settings.logLevelHint: Verbosity of the server logs, applied immediately
settings.ipBlockHint: IP, CIDR or dotted-quad wildcard, comma-separated, e.g. 192.168.1.1, 10.0.0.0/8, 192.168.*.*
settings.tokensHint: Full tokens are shown only at creation
settings.tokenNeverExpires: Tokens never expire — delete them manually when no longer needed.
settings.disconnectConfirm: This will drop the stored server connection and return to the connect screen.
settings.tokenRevokeConfirm: Deleting this token revokes it immediately. Every request using it will fail and the app will disconnect. This cannot be undone.
